introHtml: Polar Camel barware brings rugged, double-wall vacuum insulation to your branded drinkware lineup. These tumblers and growlers keep beverages ice-cold or piping hot for hours, making them a favorite for corporate gifts, trade show giveaways, and employee rewards. The durable stainless steel construction and powder-coated finish allow for crisp logo imprinting via laser engraving or screen printing. Choose custom Polar Camel barware when you need a premium, long-lasting promotional item that recipients will actually use every day.
